about: Legato switch probe (2026-10-16, branch legato-switch, tools/soundlibraries/legato_switch/probe.py): kthost + Kontakt 8 + SSO on the Windows test VM, MuseScore setups of Violins 1 / Violins 2 - Performance, take A (seed A) only, stopped early (the owner chose an own sample-based legato patch). Rows: one transition each, arrive / leave / glideArrive ms after its note-on (pYIN 30-cent rule / YIN phi 0.1 / 0.9), level dBFS (loudest 50 ms). Violins 2: files 1-2 of 4.
